content:
nora: Heads-up: product team needs to lock the private-deploy roadmap this sprint. Goal: predictable upgrades for customer-managed networks and an operator-friendly package.

diego: Important not to break customer IP ownership. Propose 2 upgrade lanes: 
- inplace-preserve (preferred for static-peering)
- blue-green-managed (for cloud-managed nets)
Both need validation harness.

ashley: Can we get an automated validation harness that simulates peering + routing for each tenant config? Idea: run operatorctl simulate --topology static-peering --seed tenant-012 -> outputs pass/fail + route-diff.

mike: ops note: simulate should include DNS TTL and ARP/gratuitous-ARP timing. In past customers saw a 90s window where clients re-resolved and failed. We should capture that.

nora: Launch acceptance (initial draft):
- Installer supports both airgap and online modes
- Inplace-preserve lane proves zero-IP-change for 5 pilot tenants
- Integration tests for KMS/HSM key-access during upgrade
- Migration simulation harness with deterministic seed
- Operator rollback < 15 minutes to known-good config
- Telemetry hooks for per-tenant latency & connection errors

diego: Add: documented network handshake API for customer netops (POST /handshake/v1/prepare, GET /handshake/v1/status). Clients must confirm readiness before cutover.

ashley: UX ask: operatorctl should have a dry-run flag and a human-friendly summary:
```
operatorctl upgrade --lane inplace-preserve --tenant tenant-012 --dry-run
# SUMMARY: 2 ACL changes, 0 IP reassigns, estimated cutover 45s
```

mike: Ops dependency: we need a small ephemeral gateway for fallthrough in blue-green-managed. We'll require NAT and a short L3 proxy. Also need an ACL-diff utility to apply diffs atomically.

nora: Risk gating: compute a per-release migration-risk score (algorithmic):
- topology-complexity (0-4) + key-dependency (0-3) + customer-size (0-3) => 0-10.
Score >6 requires cross-functional signoff + legal ok for HSM customers.

diego: Pilot plan: identify 6 tenants split by topology (2 static-peering, 2 vpc-peering, 2 cloud-proxy). Run validation harness -> run dry-run upgrade -> schedule 1-hour maintenance window.

ashley: Docs: operator runbook must include: preflight checklist, ACL-diff example, handshake request/response examples, rollback commands, and DNS sticky notes. I'll draft and link to docs.redwood/internal/private-upgrade.

product-bot: [note] auto-created epic: PRD-PLAT-532 private-upgrade-lanes (https://projects/redwood/PRD-PLAT-532)

mike: One more: telemetry tags must include release-version, lane, tenant-topology. We need this to detect regressions quickly.

nora: OK owners: nora (PM), diego (network lead), ashley (operator docs + tooling), mike (ops readiness). I'll circulate the acceptance checklist and the pilot tenant list by EOD. Meeting tomorrow 11:30 to finalise bundling stance (thin agent vs full installer). Thanks. :white_check_mark:
